summary: Wave 105.8/105.9/105.10 e2e testing. Backend: new pytest suite (18 tests, 16 pass) covering bulk toner upload color persistence, supplier listing/printer feeds, image_urls PUT persistence, upload guards, auth/me roles. Frontend: real dealer login (fresh approved QA supplier) → verified bulk-upload grid row alignment (BUG FIX 1), color coercion via real CSV import (BUG FIX 2), listing search/brand/max-price filters + reset (FEATURE 3), /supplier/bulk-images page incl. a REAL image upload that persisted (FEATURE 4), plus 390px mobile layout. No JSX runtime errors, no console/pageerror on /supplier or /supplier/bulk-images. 2 real defects found: BulkImageUpload calls a non-existent GET /supplier/printers (405 → printers never appear), and Razorpay create-order fails with 'Authentication failed'.

critical.issue: Route does not exist (405 Method Not Allowed — only POST + GET /supplier/printers/mine exist). BulkImageUpload.jsx line 63 calls api.get('/supplier/printers') and swallows the error with .catch(()=>({data:[]})), so PRINTER listings without photos NEVER show on /supplier/bulk-images. Fix: use '/supplier/printers/mine'.

Returns 400 'Razorpay rejected the order: Authentication failed'. /api/payments/config-check shows key_id rzp_test_TNm… + secret len 24 + client initialised, so the KEY_ID/KEY_SECRET pair in the preview env is mismatched/invalid. No payment was attempted. Checkout payment cannot be started in preview.

minor.issue: Endpoint is unauthenticated — any anonymous caller can create Razorpay orders (abuse/noise risk). Consider require_user + server-side amount derivation from the cart/order.

ui_bugs.issue: After uploading the 1st photo the row is immediately filtered out of the list (rows memo only keeps listings with zero images), so slots 1 and 2 become unreachable — the '3 upload slots per row' promise only ever delivers 1 photo per visit. Suggest keeping the row visible until the user leaves/reloads (e.g. freeze the row set on load, or keep rows that were rendered).
data-testid 'bulk-img-slot-0/1/2' is duplicated for every row (non-unique). Scope it per row, e.g. bulk-img-slot-{id}-{index}.

No success toast was detected after a successful upload in the automated run (upload itself worked and persisted). Toast may be rendering outside the sonner container or too briefly — worth a manual confirm.

integration_issues.issue: Printer listings are silently dropped due to the wrong endpoint (see backend_issues). Page only ever shows toners.

issues: VERIFIED FIXED: all 4 imported rows measured exactly 77px pitch (y = 377.1 / 454.1 / 531.1 / 608.1); filled rows show bulk-breakdown-{idx}, empty rows show the '·' placeholder — no zig-zag.
Row wraps to 2 lines cleanly, document scrollWidth == innerWidth (390) — no overflow.
The floating 'Feedback' tab sits on the right edge at the same vertical band as the 'Add photos in bulk' button (button ends x=366, viewport 390) — visually crowded on mobile.
Left model column is squeezed to ~60px by the 3 fixed 56px slots — model text truncates to 'HP · T…'; consider stacking slots below the model line at <420px.

action_items: BulkImageUpload.jsx: change api.get('/supplier/printers') → '/supplier/printers/mine' (printers currently never listed).
Fix RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET pair in the preview backend env — create-order returns 400 'Authentication failed'.
Keep bulk-image rows visible after the first upload so slots 1/2 are usable.
Make bulk-img-slot testids unique per row.
Delete QA supplier qa.w10510.ui.76ecfbca@example.com after sign-off (cleanup command in /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
critical_code_review_comments: BulkImageUpload.uploadFor(): the PUT→PATCH fallback swallows the real error of the PUT (e.g. a 422 validation) and retries a PATCH that does not exist for these routes; log/report the original error instead.

BulkImageUpload nextUrls[slotIdx] = url on a sparse array then .filter(Boolean) silently re-indexes slots, so a photo dropped into slot 2 becomes slot 0 — acceptable but surprising; document or block out-of-order slots.
SupplierDashboard.jsx is 1814 lines — split (filters bar, toner grid, orders table, bulk sections) per the 700-line guideline.
listing-filter-count always prints 'N of listings.length' even when the Printers/Papers tab is active (visibleAllProducts is the filtered set there) — count can mismatch what is on screen.
eslint warning still present: SupplierDashboard.jsx:392 useEffect missing deps 'load'/'loadAllProducts'.

success_rate.frontend: 90% — all 4 target features work; 1 integration gap (printers) + minor UX issues

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified working: (1) bulk-upload toner grid alignment — measure y of [data-testid=bulk-cell-{i}-price], pitch must be constant (was 77px); (2) color coercion — import /tmp/qa_toner_bulk.csv style CSV, Black→Black, cyan→Cyan, MAGENTA→Magenta, Neon→Neon; (3) listing search/brand/price filters + reset all correct (counts 3→1→0→3); (4) /supplier/bulk-images lists only photo-less listings, real upload persisted after reload (2→1). NOTE: a Marketplace Seller Agreement modal (data-testid=agreement-gate) blocks all clicks for a brand-new dealer — check the 'I agree' checkbox and click 'Start listing' first; also dismiss the cookie 'Accept' banner. Backend suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_wave105_10_bulk_color_images.py (2 known failures = the two reported defects). Razorpay was NOT charged; only create-order/config-check probed.
rca_of_the_issue: Printers gap: BulkImageUpload.jsx uses GET /supplier/printers, but backend only registers POST /supplier/printers, POST /supplier/printers/bulk and GET /supplier/printers/mine, so FastAPI answers 405; the .catch fallback returns an empty array, so the page silently renders toners only and the 'N listings without photos' count under-reports. Razorpay: /api/payments/config-check confirms both env vars are loaded and the client initialises, so the 400 comes from Razorpay itself rejecting the key/secret pair (invalid or mixed test key_id with live secret) in the preview environment.
